studentProfile.title: Student Profile
studentProfile.description: Information about the logged-in student, their class grade, and subject preferences

userId.description: Unique user ID matching the authenticated Firebase user

grade.description: Active grade category of the student

board.description: Selectable educational board (e.g. CBSE, ICSE, State Board)

mediumOfLearning.description: Preferred language for interaction (e.g. English, Hindi, Hinglish)

classSession.title: Classroom Session
classSession.description: An interactive classroom session with blackboard state, active syllabus document, and session metadata

sessionId.description: Unique session ID generated on startup

activeDocumentName.description: Name of the active syllabus document, if any

customBoardContent.description: Current blackboard chalk and neon diagram state

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the session was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last session state modification

dialogueMessage.title: Dialogue Message
dialogueMessage.description: A transcripts of verbal communication exchanged during the session between the student and Cherry Ma'am

messageId.description: Unique identifier of the transcription message block

sessionId.description: Session ID this message belongs to

text.description: Verbal transcript sentence or response block

boardSnapshot.title: Board Snapshot
boardSnapshot.description: Whiteboard image snapshots with custom topic titles and descriptions saved to student profiles.

snapshotId.description: Unique snapshot ID generated on creation

topicTitle.description: Title of the board topic discussed

description.description: Short description of the topic discussed

imgData.description: Compressed Base64 JPEG data representing the blackboard snapshot

timestamp.description: Time when the snapshot was stored

quizAttempt.title: Quiz Attempt
quizAttempt.description: Historical record of practice quizzes completed by the student

attemptId.description: Unique ID for the quiz attempt

source.description: Source of quiz questions (e.g. present_topic, document, static)

docName.description: Name of the document or topic

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the attempt was submitted

battleRoom.title: Battle Room
battleRoom.description: A multiplayer quiz battle room with syllabus, schedule, questions, and participant tracking

code.description: 6-digit or formatted room join code (e.g. CHERRY-4821)

title.description: Title or exam name of the battle room

chapterOrFileName.description: Syllabus topic or uploaded document name

scheduledTimestamp.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds for countdown timer

hostUid.description: Firebase UID of the host student

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the room

questions.description: List of generated MCQs for the room

battleParticipant.title: Battle Participant
battleParticipant.description: A player joined into a battle room with status, score, and answer timestamps

isHost.description: Whether this participant is the room host

isReady.description: Whether the player is ready in the lobby

subscriptionSettings.title: Subscription Settings & UPI Config
subscriptionSettings.description: Global custom subscription plans and receiver UPI VPA address configured by the Admin

upiConfig.description: Active receiver UPI ID and merchant name

updatedBy.description: Email of admin who updated the settings

studentSubscription.title: Student Subscription Record
studentSubscription.description: Student UTR payment record, active plan tier, validity period, and approval status

isPro.description: Whether the student has active Pro privileges

approvedBy.description: Admin email who verified the payment

systemNotice.title: System Notice / Announcement
systemNotice.description: Real-time notice published by administrators for student announcements, class timings, or emergency alerts

isActive.description: Whether the notice is actively shown on student dashboards

actionLink.description: Optional CTA destination or target screen

publishedBy.description: Admin email who published the notice

/systemNotices/{noticeId}.description: Real-time announcements and emergency notices published by Admin for students

/systemConfig/{configId}.description: System configuration holding custom subscription plans and receiver UPI details

/studentSubscriptions/{subId}.description: Student subscriptions and UPI UTR payment references verified by admin

/studentProfiles/{userId}.description: Stores user-specific settings matching their UID

/studentProfiles/{userId}/boardSnapshots.description: Whiteboard image snapshots and descriptions saved under specific student profiles

/studentProfiles/{userId}/quizAttempts/{.description: Past quiz performance attempts for the student

/classSessions/{sessionId}/dialogueMessa.description: Subcollection holding full historical chat/vocal transcript dialogue histories

/battleRooms/{roomId}.description: Multiplayer battle quiz rooms accessible to participants via room code

/battleRooms/{roomId}/participants/{part.description: Players joined in the multiplayer battle room
